svg.title: XbrlRag architecture
svg.desc: SEC EDGAR Inline XBRL filings (10-K, 10-Q and IFRS 20-F) for 33 filers are ingested in two arms: Arelle loads the tagged facts into Postgres and assigns each a fact_id, then registries and concept mapping are built; the prose arm renders canonical HTML, assigns sections and DOM positions, and chunks, cross-links and embeds the text. A publish gate rebuilds 19 materialized views and runs trust gates before anything is served. Two stores result, a Postgres fact store and a Qdrant narrative index, linked by fact_id. At query time the LLM decomposes, routes and plans while SQL resolves companies and periods; the executor runs lookup, compute, screen, breakdown and narrative steps with deterministic SQL and sandboxed arithmetic. A cited synthesis is checked by an independent faithfulness verifier, and every number walks back through its fact_id to the filing and the source HTML. Answers are served over a BFF, an analyst API, an MCP server and a React UI, with evaluation and a controls spine alongside.
svg.text: FACTS ARM · ARELLE ASSIGNS fact_id FIRST
PROSE ARM · BRIDGES BACK VIA xml_id → fact_id
Publish gate · rebuild 18 views → trust gates → publish_manifest
v2: XbrlRag vs a frontier SEC agent
independent SEC answer keys, held-out sets
the LLM proposes intent; SQL resolves it
Fuzzy intent, deterministic resolution · the planner never sees the taxonomy or the schema; a resolver maps its hints to exact concepts, members and periods
deterministic SQL and sandboxed arithmetic, no LLM
Narrow, logged fallbacks · sub-family → Revenue · glued-member split · sibling intersection · derived gross profit · each a decision event in the trace
unanswered parts named · declines rather than guesses
every number walks back to its filing
NUMERIC LINEAGE · RESOLVED BY SQL, NOT BY THE MODEL
Per-query trace · every LLM call (prompt, response, cost) · the exact fact-store SQL
persisted to audit.* · Trace Explorer · Prometheus /metrics → Grafana
the same services as agent tools
one LLMGateway for every call: retry · per-stage model tiers · escalation · rate limiter · per-run budget + circuit breaker
versioned prompt registry · semantic query cache · untrusted filing text fenced as data · torch-free serving image · local or AWS mode
